scope: Scale the frozen SF-Q static independent-expert recipe; tracker is a separate optional ablation
splits: Complete scene layouts and all views/weather variants stay in a single split. Historical validation/test never become train.
condition_holdout: New time/severity/weather combinations from existing sensor physics; no claim of an unseen physical sensor-fault family
heldout_assets: Not feasible with the present 15-asset catalog: historical training already exposed the catalog. No held-out-mesh acceptance claim.

training.raw_selection: highest clean validation mAP every epoch, latest tie

controls: Frozen SF-Q ensemble on exactly the same new validation/test observations

volume_selection.expansion: Only when current volume passes promotion and yields >=.005 incremental gain over previous accepted volume. Stop for disk/time reserve or at 30k.
volume_selection.no_gain: Retain the smaller previously accepted ensemble; report the scaled contender as a negative result

test_policy: Freeze source, recipe, data and all candidate/control checkpoint hashes after volume selection. Score sealed test once; never select or tune on it.
uncertainty: Sample SD across three disjoint complete 18-network ensembles; not dataset-sampling confidence or stability of one initialization.
temporal: Apply the previously frozen SF-14 parameters without tuning; report exploratory historical-clip ablation separately from fresh static acceptance.

capture_benchmark.correctness: Byte-identical data inventories; only runtime telemetry excluded
capture_benchmark.limits: Short matched pilot; storage maintenance overlapped initial measurements. Repeat baseline/winner after maintenance.
